releases.new: Add st.grid for responsive grid layouts, plus a required parameter on date, time, datetime, text area and selectbox inputs.
releases.breaking: Default theme colors, surfaces, borders and map markers changed, so apps relying on the default look may appear different; check custom styling after upgrading.

releases.new: Add on_change="ignore" to many widgets such as color_picker, data_editor, pills and segmented_control, and test forms and more widgets with AppTest.
releases.breaking: Python 3.10 support is dropped, so upgrade to Python 3.11 or newer. Apps now render in opaque sandboxed iframes, and httptools is now optional.

releases.new: Add alt text to many elements such as images, charts, tables and dataframes, and show st.dialog as a side drawer using the position parameter.
Add native Apache ECharts charts with st.echarts_chart, plus async-aware caching and an on_change ignore mode for number_input, selectbox and select_slider.
releases.breaking: Inverted st.number_input min/max bounds are now rejected, unsupported on_change modes raise errors, and the mapbox.token config option is removed; fix bounds, modes and config.

releases.new: Add icons to st.button, st.download_button, st.form_submit_button, st.link_button and st.popover, and let st.pydeck_chart support selection.
Pass many more data types, such as Polars, Dask, xarray, Ray, and Pydantic objects, directly to Streamlit's dataframe and data-handling functions.
releases.breaking: Experimental cached widget replay logic was removed, so code relying on replaying widgets inside cached functions will stop working; move widget calls outside cached functions.

releases.new: Add a feedback widget, stacking options for bar and area charts, and stable st.fragment and st.dialog without the experimental prefix.
releases.breaking: Several deprecated experimental features and old config options were removed, including the showPyplotGlobalUse option; replace removed experimental calls with stable versions and delete removed config settings.

releases.new: Build multipage apps with the new navigation and page objects, which let you define pages and their navigation directly in code.
releases.breaking: Legacy caching logic was removed and the experimental_allow_widgets caching parameter is deprecated; update any code that relied on the old caching behavior.
